title: CENTE MUCARA - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
| MUCARA MAMEGI MA KINGOLO MUCORO IYE DWE ACEL ACEL | WEL CENTE MUCORO |
| --- | --- |
| Ma pe kato Shs.  235,000 | Pe kingolo gin moo |
| Makato shs. 235,000 ento pe kato  Shs. 335,000 | 10% me cente ma otyeko kato ki iwi Shs. 235000 |
| Makato shs. 335,000 ento pe kato Shs. 410,000 | Shs. 10,000 med ikom 20% me cente ma otyeko kato ki iwi Shs. 335,000 |
| Makato Shs. 410,000 | (a)     Shs. 45,500 med ikom 30% me cente ma otyeko kato ki iwii Shs. 410,000 (b)     ka inen wel cente ma omyero kingol mucoro iye kato shs. 10,000,000 pi dwe acel, ci dok pacent 10 mukene kingolo ki iwi cente ma otyeko kato ki iwi shs. 10,000,000 |

headers: MUCARA MAMEGI MA KINGOLO MUCORO IYE DWE ACEL ACEL
rows: Makato shs. 235,000 ento pe kato  Shs. 335,000
10% me cente ma otyeko kato ki iwi Shs. 235000
Makato shs. 335,000 ento pe kato Shs. 410,000
Shs. 10,000 med ikom 20% me cente ma otyeko kato ki iwi Shs. 335,000

(a)     Shs. 45,500 med ikom 30% me cente ma otyeko kato ki iwii Shs. 410,000 (b)     ka inen wel cente ma omyero kingol mucoro iye kato shs. 10,000,000 pi dwe acel, ci dok pacent 10 mukene kingolo ki iwi cente ma otyeko kato ki iwi shs. 10,000,000
